name: Machines
description: Register machines (SSH hosts today), run commands on them, move files between them and the artifact library, and update git checkouts on them.

allowedHosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts agents may register and use, one per entry: host, user@host, host:port or user@host:port (IPv6 as [addr]:port). Empty (the default) means agents can register no machine at all. A stored machine whose host is taken off this list is refused the next time it is used. Agents cannot change this setting.

allowedIdentityFiles.title: Allowed identity files
allowedIdentityFiles.description: Private key paths (absolute or ~/...) a machine may reference as identity_file. Machines without identity_file use ssh-agent (use_agent) or, when Allow default keys is on, ssh's default keys (use_default_keys). Empty (the default) means no key file may be named. The pack never reads the key.

allowDefaultKeys.title: Allow default keys
allowDefaultKeys.description: Let machines registered with use_default_keys=true use ssh's default ~/.ssh key files. Off (the default) means a machine needs identity_file or use_agent. Agents cannot change this setting.

sshAuthSock.title: ssh-agent socket
sshAuthSock.description: Absolute path of the ssh-agent socket (the value of SSH_AUTH_SOCK in your shell; on Windows the agent pipe, \\.\pipe\openssh-ssh-agent). Used only for machines registered with use_agent=true; the pack's ssh runs with a bare environment, so set this for agent auth.
